title: MapLatestResponse
description: GET /map/latest (services/api/README.md): the map version map_head points at, with the URLs of its files, for the owner's tools on the LAN (the mapper app and the change-set preview). Public clients read latest.json instead, which can lag map_head until the reconcile job runs (docs/snapshot-format.md). Before the first publish the route answers 404 with an ErrorResponse. Holds nothing private: no publisher, private export key or note.

published_at.description: When the version was published (map_versions.published_at), in Singapore time.

snapshot_sha256.description: The version's content hash (map_versions.snapshot_sha256), which names its directory.

restores.description: For a rollback, the version it restored (map_versions.restores); null otherwise.

demo.description: true when the map is the demonstration data of pnpm demo (the database holds the demo), as latest.json's demo says; absent otherwise.

file.title: MapLatestFile
file.description: One file of the version: its path under the root of the public files, and a URL to fetch it from.

path.description: Path relative to the root of the public files: snapshots/<snapshot_sha256>/indoor.json or street.json.

url.description: Where to fetch it: the path under API_PUBLIC_FILES_URL when that is set, otherwise under this API's GET /public/.
